page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance type does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. It does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The high memory density relative to the processing cores makes this instance class suitable for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. It is designed for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, and heavy data processing tasks where massive RAM capacity is required to keep active datasets in memory, offsetting the lack of local storage through high-speed network throughput.
